overview.description: The VistaShares Defense Supercycle ETF (AMMO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in global companies supporting the defense procurement supply chain. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by focusing on businesses positioned to benefit from long-term defense procurement trends. AMMO was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by VistaShares.

holdings.infoBox: AMMO is an equity ETF with a total of 53 individual holdings. The top holdings are LIG Defense&Aerospace stock at 4.60%, MilDef Group AB at 4.03%, Rheinmetall AG at 3.62%, Kitron ASA at 3.49%, and Palantir Technologies at 3.40%.
